name: Bilge Rat Day — Quarterly Deep Inspection
source: KB: squid-on-board-binder / Monthly Maintenance Checklists + squid-maintenance-checklists
intro: Quarterly deep inspection of motors, shaft seals, and below-deck systems. Takes about 45 minutes. Do this roughly every 3 months or when engine hours indicate.

help.title: Thermometer gear
help.body: Check the thermometer sensor and its connection on each gearbox. Look for loose fittings, corrosion on contacts, or damaged wiring. Confirm the gauge reads within normal range when engines are cold.

items.label: Inspect cooling hoses and hose clamps

help.title: ATF leak check
help.body: Automatic transmission fluid (ATF) lubricates the shaft seal. Look for pink/red fluid weeping around the seal housing or dripping into the bilge. A small sheen is normal; active dripping means the seal needs attention.

help.title: Shaft seal diapers
help.body: The absorbent pads (diapers) under the shaft seals catch small ATF drips and prevent bilge contamination. Replace if saturated or discolored. Keep spares in the dock box.

items.label: Ensure water is not leaking into thrust bearing bulkhead compartment

help.title: Thrust bearing bulkhead
help.body: Open the thrust bearing bulkhead compartment and look for standing water or moisture. Water intrusion here can damage the thrust bearing and cause shaft misalignment. If water is present, identify the source before closing up.

items.label: Inspect hose clamps on sea strainers
Operate sea cocks — close and then open

help.title: Sea cock exercise
help.body: Sea cocks (through-hull valves) can seize if not exercised regularly. Close each one fully, then reopen. They should move smoothly. If stiff, apply marine grease to the handle mechanism. Never leave a sea cock in the closed position when done — reopen after testing.

items.label: Bilge wipedown with dawn/water then bleach water and towel
Forepeak clean/organized — bleach water and towel, clean out resting water
Photo of bilge/machine space after cleaning (optional)

completion.notes_prompt: Any deficiencies found? Describe corrective actions needed.
